title: How toxic is antisemitism? Potentials and limitations of automated toxicity scoring for antisemitic online content
reasoning: The paper focuses on the evaluation of automated tools for detecting antisemitism, which is a specific form of religious and ethnic prejudice. It uses definitions from religious and historical organizations (like the IHRA) and analyzes content related to Jewish identity, stereotypes, and Holocaust denial/distortion, placing it within the realm of evaluating responses to faith-related and ethical issues.
